run_loop_experiment: run a reinforcement learning experiment loop with an agent, environment, and accumulator for training and evaluation
initialize_agent_params: initialize agent parameters and learner state using a PRNG seed for reproducible reinforcement learning
step_agent_environment: step the agent-environment interaction loop by selecting actions and advancing timesteps
accumulate_experience: accumulate experience tuples in a replay buffer for batched reinforcement learning updates
evaluate_agent_performance: evaluate agent performance by running evaluation episodes and computing average returns
